# FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-Julia (FAIRBioHeaders.jl)

> Julia reader and verifier for FAIR-bioHeaders metadata headers (FHR reference-genome
> FASTA/GFA, FHP protein FASTA, FHGFF3 GFF3 annotation). Headers are YAML blocks inside
> the data file (`;~` in FASTA, `#~` in GFA/GFF3), validated against the per-type JSON
> Schema contracts and covered by a SHA-512/256 checksum of the file's exact bytes. The
> rules and contracts belong to FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification; header *writing* belongs
> to the Python toolkit `fair-bioheaders`. This package only reads and verifies.

Key facts (against FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification release v0.6.0, bundled byte-for-byte
under `schemas/` with SHA-256 provenance — contract versions FHR `schemaVersion: '2.1'`,
FHP `'1.2'`, FHGFF3 `'1.2'`):

- Status: development only. Not in the Julia General registry, no release tag. Do not
  claim or describe a published Julia package.
- FHT and FHGM have no released contract (rule V7): no `schemaVersion`, no w3id URL, no
  support claim. By default a citation of either is treated like any unknown `schema`
  value under rule V5 (read as current FHR). The opt-in `drafts = true` lane reads the
  digest-pinned draft bytes under `drafts/` and warns on every record; draft suites run
  only in the labelled `draft-lane` CI job and never join the shared 291-vector ledger.
- The digest is Julia stdlib `SHA` (`SHA2_512_256_CTX` + padded base64, rule R4) and is
  byte-equal to the released Python toolkit's `hashlib` digest; the measurement and the
  validator-selection study are in `docs/CAPABILITY.md`.
- Contract validation uses `CorvusJsonSchema` with `assert_format = true`, because the
  contracts declare JSON Schema **draft/2020-12** and `format: date`/`format: uri` must
  bind. `JSONSchema.jl` 1.6.0 was measured unsuitable (silently ignores `format`;
  falsely rejects the legal FHGFF3 `annotates` genome link).
- The YAML metadata block is read by this package's own strict reader: YAML.jl accepts
  duplicate keys, anchors/aliases, merge keys and explicit tags (all invalid under rule
  R8/R12), type-resolves scalars that YAML 1.1 and 1.2 disagree on (rule R12) and folds
  multi-line plain scalars differently from every other family reader.

```julia
import Pkg; Pkg.add(url = "https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-Julia")
using FAIRBioHeaders
r = verify_file("genome.fhr.fasta")   # bytes + header rules + contract, per-rule findings
r.ok; r.stated; r.computed; r.errors; r.warnings; r.not_checked
```

API: `verify_file`, `read_fhr_file`, `read_fhr_header`, `header_checksum`,
`validate_record`, `select_contract`, `parse_citation`, `bundled_contracts`,
`link_scheme_warnings`, `run_conformance`, `summarise`, `read_file_bytes`,
`is_gzip`, `decompress_gzip`.

Acceptance is the shared conformance suite of FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification (291 vectors
at tag v0.6.0), never a Julia-only suite. Measured 2026-11-14: **228 pass / 0 fail /
63 undecided** — all four sequence formats fully decided, including the 11 compressed
(gzip/BGZF) vectors, decompressed natively through the `CodecZlib` boundary isolated in
`src/gzip.jl` (the pure-Julia `Inflate` truncates multi-member and BGZF streams and is
rejected). The 26 microdata and 37 JSON-LD vectors are reported undecided by this
reader with their reasons — see `docs/CONFORMANCE.md`.

## See also

- Specification, rules and released schemas: https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification (its `llms.txt` is the family-wide entry point)
- Reference toolkit (writes headers and checksums): https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools
- Local: `README.md`, `docs/CAPABILITY.md`, `docs/CONFORMANCE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `LICENSE`

## Independent review and merge authorization (2026-11-18)

Never push directly to the default branch. Use a PR under this authorization.

The maintainer's independent-review rule (2026-11-18) applies only to
FAIR-bioHeaders repositories and agents operated by David Molik (`molikd`) or
Adam Wright (`adamjohnwright`). A PR submitted by either maintainer or their
agents may satisfy the approval gate through an independent **different model**:
Copilot, or a model operated by David or Adam. The approving model/agent must be
other than the submitter; an agent must not self-approve its PR, and another
instance of the same model does not satisfy the different-model requirement.
Record author/reviewer model provenance when needed to establish independence.
David and Adam themselves may self-approve their PRs; this exception does not
apply to their agents.

An eligible agent may merge only after that approval requirement is met, all
applicable CI checks are green, and its own validation of the current changes
passes, including changes after review. Recheck the exact head, base branch,
findings and dependencies immediately before merging. Missing checks are not
passing checks, and branch protection must not be bypassed. Read every overall
review and inline finding, reply with its disposition and fix/evidence, resolve
handled threads, and post an overall response. Merge authorization does not grant
contract adoption, curator acceptance, release, publication or deployment
authority; those retain their separate maintainer gates.

Authority: [approval by another, different model](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification/issues/268#issuecomment-6984337685)
and [human self-approval exception](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification/issues/268#issuecomment-6984418624).

Port source: FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification commit
`0d0d6b43efdee96bc7548f1f7c65fdafb2a31f32` ([specification PR #269](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification/pull/269)).
